name: Astera asUSDT liquidity index inflation
summary: Astera's Oracle priced minipool collateral wrapping main-pool aTokens through the main pool's liquidity index, and the main pool's flash-loan repayment added each premium to that index over the aToken's total supply. Borrowing USDT with unwrap from all three minipools burned asUSDT down to about 97 USDT of supply, 5,600 flash loans then pushed the asUSDT index from 1 to 154, and the 154-times overvalued collateral borrowed out the minipools' asUSD, LINEA, WETH and other assets.

campaign.selection: every call with selector 0xdcde02fa from 0x9520c9040338be61005590cc1bd15caa10a6613c to its contract 0x76f844359ffbe267f4c02ffd76184e27b1aebe6b (50 USDT flash loans per transaction, inflating the asUSDT liquidity index)

notes: Anchor: the setup transaction (post-mortem phase 1) that deposited and borrowed USDT with unwrap through all three minipools, shrinking asUSDT supply; it ran the minipools' unwrap path and the Oracle's index-based collateral pricing. The 112 index-inflation transactions and the drain are the campaign; 20 earlier calls through the attacker's first contract 0x08ef8c80 did no flash loans.

Targets: the main LendingPool (flash-loan premium added to the liquidity index over a manipulable supply), the Oracle (aToken collateral priced via that index) and the three minipools whose unwrap borrow shrank the supply and whose collateral it overvalued. The minipools' resets are their USDT-wrapper (0x1579072d) reserve listings; minipool 0x52280ea8's (2025-09-08) is the latest. Later minipool and main-pool changes before the exploit are reserve-factor tweaks, interest-rate strategy swaps and other assets' listings that the anchor did not need.

Loss: gross outflows of the three minipool aToken vaults and the main-pool aWETH/aWBTC reserves that paid out the unwrapped borrows, including the setup's 11 USDT and 207 USDC borrows; wrapper share tokens are omitted as they mirror the underlying flows. $440k later rescued and $380k frozen by Linea (post-mortem) are recoveries, not subtracted.
The l2beat Linea RPC failed historical eth_getStorageAt ("storage data is truncated") and gave a reverted trace for the drain; rpc.linea.build was used.
